name: pmd
description: Extensible multilanguage static code analyzer for Java, Apex, and 16+ other languages with 400+ built-in rules

pmd.description: Advanced source code analyzer that detects bugs, code quality issues, performance problems, and security vulnerabilities across multiple languages
pmd.usage:
pmd check -d src/ -R rulesets/java/quickstart.xml -f text
pmd check -d . -R category/java/errorprone.xml -f xml -r report.xml
pmd check -d MyProject.java -R rulesets/java/quickstart.xml --minimum-priority HIGH
pmd check -d src/ -R custom-rules.xml -f json --show-suppressed
pmd cpd --minimum-tokens 100 --language java --files src/
